propositions: A new peer confirmation store must persist outbound link additions with vendor link id, direction, confirmed pass, and source kind to distinguish never-pushed local refs from peer-deleted ones

The confirmation record key is (source_local_id, target_local_id, relation) matching the inbound removal path's relation-scoped scope, and unbound targets must skip recording entirely to avoid persisting vendor keys
The write seam sits after set_relationship succeeds in _update_one_dispatch_links via an optional link_confirm callback that never fails the outbound link and is swallowed on exception
Durability requires staging the store file in both _rel_files and _tracked_basenames so confirmation-only changes survive the bug-1e08 idempotency gate in _commit_binding_store_snapshot
Load must be fail-open: corrupt or absent peer_confirmations.json yields an empty store without raising, and survives snapshot compaction
The production write point is apply_handlers.handle_update via BatchApplyContext (no new plumbing needed), not apply_outbound, and must translate Jira keys to local ids
